Class ExternalArc

java.lang.Object
ua.stetsenkoinna.petriobj.ExternalArc
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ExternalArc extends Object implements Serializable
A weighted arc from a transition of one Petri-object into a place that belongs to another Petri-object.

Arcs inside a single Petri net are stored as indices into the net's own place array (PetriT.getInP() / PetriT.getOutP()), which makes them meaningless across net boundaries. An external arc therefore holds a direct reference to the foreign PetriP instead, so the transition can produce tokens in a place owned by a different Petri-object.

External arcs are never part of a PetriNet: they are wired by PetriObjModel.applyLinks() from the model's link declarations and are dropped by PetriNet.clone(), so a cloned model rebuilds them from the same declarations.
